request.summary: Add a --format csv flag to the widget-export CLI

shared_understanding.statement: `--format csv` writes the same records as `--format json`, as CSV with a header row.
Only the export CLI's output formatting changes; the export query and record set are unchanged.
CSV fields are comma-separated with double-quote escaping, matching Python's csv module defaults.
`widget-export --format csv` on the fixture dataset produces a header row plus one row per record, byte-identical across runs.
None needed; CSV formatting behavior is fully determined by the existing record schema.
This does not add a --format tsv or --format xlsx flag; those are separate requests if ever needed.
